**In one line**: OpenAI laid out more of its safety philosophy and called for international cooperation to build standards for frontier AI.

### Key points
- OpenAI reportedly expanded on the approach it uses to manage risks in its most advanced ("frontier") models.
- It urged cooperation across nations — rather than a single company or country — to shape shared standards.
- The move extends an ongoing industry debate over whether governance can keep pace with capability gains.

### Why it matters
If risk management for frontier models is left to each company's discretion, standards fragment. A leading developer publicly backing international coordination could influence how national regulators and industry-wide norms take shape.
